text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with 14 field reps for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**The wins:** Reps reclaimed roughly 5 hours a week on CRM updates. Follow-up emails went out same-day instead of next-day. Managers finally saw what customers actually said, not just what reps remembered.

**The surprises:** Adoption spiked when reps could edit summaries before syncing. It stalled when they couldn't. Customers rarely objected to recording, as long as we asked upfront and explained why.

**The misses:** Noisy sites and side conversations in hallways produced messy transcripts. Accuracy on product names needed a custom vocabulary list.

**Our takeaway:** The tool didn't make reps better sellers. It gave them time and context to be better ones.

Piloting something similar? Start with consent and editing controls.

*(Synthetic scenario for illustration.)*
